title: FedRAMP-style access reviews in the admin console
prompt: Add FedRAMP-style access reviews to the admin console

steps.text: AC-2 account management wants periodic review of every privileged account, with a named reviewer, a decision, and evidence that revoked access actually went away. The admin console already lists users and roles, so the review campaign can reuse that data. The hard parts are separation of duties (nobody reviews their own access) and making revocation immediate, including live sessions.

I'll add quarterly access review campaigns mapped to NIST 800-53 AC-2(3) and AC-6(7): every privileged grant gets a reviewer decision, self-review is blocked, and a revoke kills live sessions immediately. Starting with the current admin model.

tasks.name: ControlMapping
tasks.task: Map the access review feature to the relevant NIST 800-53 controls and list the evidence each control needs from the system.
tasks.result:
# ControlMapping

AC-2(3): flag accounts idle more than 90 days. AC-2(7): privileged roles reviewed every quarter. AC-6(7): reviewer decision per grant. AU-2: review.decision and review.revoke events.
Evidence: campaign export (CSV + JSON) with reviewer, decision, timestamp and revoke confirmation.

steps.text: List the controls that an assessor will test against a review campaign.
Idle-account detection is a separate control from privilege review; both fit in one campaign.
Mapped to AC-2(3), AC-2(7), AC-6(7) and AU-2 with an evidence list per control.

tasks.name: RevokeTests
tasks.task: Write tests proving that a revoke decision removes the role and terminates live sessions, and that a reviewer cannot review their own access.

steps.text:
Access reviews are in the admin console:

- **Campaigns** per quarter cover every privileged grant (AC-2(7), AC-6(7)) and flag accounts idle over 90 days (AC-2(3)).
- **Separation of duties:** self-review is refused server-side, not just hidden in the UI.
- **Revoke is real:** the role is removed and live sessions are terminated in the same call.
- **Evidence:** signed CSV + JSON export with reviewer, decision and timestamp; every decision is an AU-2 audit event.
- 8/8 tests, SAST and authorization matrix clean.
